sdkContract.pendingState: Owned credentials/storage remain installed while global request is pending; no early SIGNED_OUT. Local removal completes before the settlement notification. Native credential-rotating getUser validation queues behind global settlement, then observes the missing session without a status request. This conservative read queue differs from measured reference independent getUser: it prevents rotating captured state and making acknowledged logout cleanup stale, not a universal parity claim.
sdkContract.renewal: Inside measured90second logout preflight margin, bounded genuine same-user renewal is actually persisted before TOKEN_REFRESHED; the renewed bearer authorizes the global request. Existing renewal is joined; manual renewal during a held global request is explicitly unavailable.
sdkContract.rejectedRenewal: Only this opted-in logout preflight can retain a genuinely unexpired original JWT after an HTTP renewal failure and use it for independent authenticated revocation. Native401 remains native401; unrelated regular-auth terminal policy is not rewritten. Actual-expired native401 clears/errors once with zero global dispatch. Transient expired preflight failure preserves state and reports error.
sdkContract.receipt: One bodyless Bearer POST, omitted cookies/refused redirects; exact same-origin200 application/json scope=global/revoked=true after owner-wide DELETE. Receipt512byte and renewal4096byte streamed bounds, strict UTF8/field checks and discarded non-2xx renewal bodies remain. No generic auth deadline/arbitrary-stall guarantee is added.
sdkContract.loginArbitration: Same-client password login during global logout waits for authenticated DELETE plus local settlement. An unconfirmed operation blocks queued login without dispatch. After an actual unconfirmed global request, this client rejects future password login with AuthSignInBlockedByUnconfirmedLogoutError: outstanding DELETE cannot be excluded.
sdkContract.explicitLimitation: This is conservative same-client arbitration, not universal reference parity. Other clients/processes cannot be serialized by this SDK. Independent backend quiescence/recovery is required before a separately constructed client is used; construction alone is not evidence the old DELETE is finished. Cancellation/lost response is not rollback; completed DELETE does not exclude later login or instantly revoke issued JWTs.
sdkContract.emptyOrRejected: No credentials, rejected caller, malformed/redirect/lost receipt and HTTP/transport failure cannot become fabricated server acknowledgement. Global denial statuses remain observable even when the reference SDK might ignore them.
